column1: # Application registry: one row per application the pipeline builds, in dependency order
# (an application is listed after everything it depends on). Tab-separated; `-` means none.
# Read by apps.sh; the columns and how to add an application are in ../skills/README.md.
# A compile command starts from empty output directories: Ant recompiles by timestamp only, so
# a class compiled against an older signature would survive and fail at run time.
